name: Brickanta
long_description: Brickanta  – agentic AI for society builders. Hundreds of construction-specific AI agents for project analysis, insights, tenders, procurement, and more. Combine the latest AI technology with your organization's project data, templates, and workflows to identify risks and opportunities early and produce better decision support. Brickanta has raised $8 million from leading AI, construction, and real estate investors behind companies like OpenAI/ChatGPT, Airbnb, Klarna, Spotify, and Plangrid-Autodesk, as well as star investors such as Mario Götze, Anton Osika, and Northzone (see movie and press). The founding team has been building and implementing AI in construction and industry since 2018 at companies such as ABB, Fabege, Husqvarna, IKEA and Konecranes.

launches.title: Brickanta 🧱 the construction estimator's best friend 👷‍♂️🏗️
launches.tagline: Cursor for construction estimation & project management
launches.body:
👋 We’re [Brickanta](https://brickanta.com/) (F25), building _cursor for construction estimation & project management._

**TL;DR**: Our AI platform analyzes construction estimates and project details to automate admin work, reduce errors, and accelerate delivery. 👉 _We’d appreciate your social media hype support and any potential intros, as we look to make more connections in the construction and real estate industry._

**Why this matters**\
Construction projects run on mountains of paperwork, drawings, and codes. Miss one item, and budgets blow up — every year, it costs the small European country of Sweden over $11 billion (according to the government itself) and the global industry _hundreds of billions_ every year. Estimators and PMs are the heroes who keep projects on track, but today they’re buried in manual work.

**How Brickanta helps**\
Our AI reads and organizes project docs, flags missing items & compliance risks, and supports cost analysis, tendering, and planning. It’s trained on standardized building protocols (starting with the Swedish versions of the Eurocodes, soon more countries) and integrates the systems that construction already runs on, like MS SharePoint, Outlook, and Teams — helping teams work faster, catch risks earlier, and protect margins.

🎥 YC Launch Video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=za8Ya5GxMRE

\*\*Excited to support?\*\*\
👷‍♂️🛠️👷‍♀️ We’re officially launching this week with exclusive media interviews, first public customer story, new brand + website, and more. Please check out and follow our newly created channels listed at the bottom to be part of the journey — and offer some hyping support :-)\
\
🏗️ We’d also love intros into construction and real estate companies - our MVP is currently focused on European markets (that share the fundamental [Eurocodes](https://eurocodes.jrc.ec.europa.eu/) framework)- where estimation and project management are critical.\
